tasks.subject: Task 0: Bootstrap betterplans from the skeleton
tasks.description: Copy the symfony-skeleton working tree into the repo, set docker project name to betterplans, install deps (league/commonmark, symfony/html-sanitizer, symfony/mcp-bundle), run migrations, and confirm `just ci` passes on the empty app.

tasks.subject: Task 1: ApiToken (PAT) entity, generator, and management UI
tasks.description: ApiToken entity (UUID id, sha256 token-hash, issue()/matches()), repository (findOneByRawToken), and owner-scoped create/list/revoke UI.

tasks.subject: Task 2: MCP HTTP transport + PAT-based authentication
tasks.description: Enable mcp http transport, add stateless ^/_mcp firewall + ApiTokenAuthenticator resolving Bearer PAT to owning User.

tasks.subject: Task 3: Document + DocumentVersion entities and Markdown renderer
tasks.description: Versioned Document/DocumentVersion entities + DocumentStatus enum + repository; MarkdownRenderer (commonmark + html-sanitizer).

tasks.subject: Task 4: Anchor value object + AnchorService (TextQuoteSelector)
tasks.description: Immutable Anchor VO (quote/prefix/suffix/offsetHint) + AnchorService.create/resolve over rendered text.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Comment + Review entities
tasks.description: Comment (embedded Anchor, author, body, resolved/orphaned, parent) + Review (verdict/reviewer/submittedAt) entities + repositories + Verdict enum.

tasks.subject: Task 6: CreateDocument command/handler + create_document MCP tool
tasks.description: CreateDocument command/handler (persist in_review doc with rendered v1) + thin create_document MCP tool returning {documentId, reviewUrl}.

tasks.subject: Task 7: get_document + get_review queries and MCP tools
tasks.description: GetDocument/GetReview read services (owner-scoped) + thin get_document/get_review MCP tools returning verdict + anchored threaded comments.

tasks.subject: Task 8: ReviseDocument command/handler + re-anchoring + revise_document tool
tasks.description: ReanchoringService (carry survivors / orphan misses), ReviseDocument command/handler (new version + re-anchor + status in_review), thin revise_document tool returning {carried, orphaned}.

tasks.subject: Task 9: list_documents MCP tool
tasks.description: list_documents MCP tool returning the authenticated user's documents with status + current version.

tasks.subject: Task 10: DocumentVoter + documents dashboard
tasks.description: DocumentVoter (document.view, owner-only) + /documents dashboard listing the user's documents.

tasks.subject: Task 11: Reviewer UI page (server-rendered)
tasks.description: DocumentReviewController + review template (layout A: rendered doc + sidebar threads + verdict bar + orphan banner); finalize Task 6 reviewUrl route.

tasks.subject: Task 12: Comment actions (add / reply / resolve)
tasks.description: AddComment/ReplyToComment/ResolveComment command/handlers + owner-only CommentController returning JSON.

tasks.subject: Task 13: SubmitReview command/handler + controller
tasks.description: SubmitReview command/handler (record Review + transition status by verdict) + owner-only submit controller.

tasks.subject: Task 14: Stimulus controllers + review-UI styling
tasks.description: comment_anchor + review Stimulus controllers (selection→offset/length→composer→fetch; reply/resolve/verdict) + bp- styling.

tasks.subject: Task 15: End-to-end review loop (Playwright)
tasks.description: Playwright spec driving the full loop: open review, select+comment, request changes, assert status badge, reload persistence.
